decisions.decision: Own cloud tenancy counts as inside the network (restates Phase 14 D-30)
decisions.rationale: Broker, S3, ClickHouse, new dashboard and Grafana move to the cloud; nothing may go to third-party model providers or SaaS the operator does not control

decisions.decision: Analytics container subscribes to MQTT and writes history.events/history.incidents; in 14.2 it reads today's lan/events/recent and lan/incidents/+/status and dedupes; no poller change
decisions.rationale: Cloud split; per-event messages belong to a later transport phase

decisions.decision: Daily availability rollup job moves from the poller to the analytics container in 14.2
decisions.rationale: Poller will have no ClickHouse or S3 access after the cloud split

decisions.decision: Add a filesystem read cache on the ClickHouse S3 disk (config only)
decisions.rationale: Forecasts read more than 31 days of history from MinIO

decisions.decision: Cloud-ready transport work is a SEPARATE phase (per-site namespace, per-event messages, last_check sample dedup, gzip + 1-min aggregation, status-by-exception); 60 s gauge freshness is fine; dashboard reads events/history from ClickHouse over HTTP
decisions.rationale: Metered 4G links and hundreds of sites

decisions.decision: Service-need tier derives from criticality by fixed mapping (critical->immediate, high->urgent, medium/low->standard); bands immediate <3 days or already critical, urgent 3-20, standard >20, horizon 90 days; confidence low <14d, medium 14-60d, high >60d with good fit; evaluate every 15 min; publish lan/needs/{need_id}/status retained QoS 1
